name: ship-check-skill
description: The 60-second pre-flight for anything you are about to ship: leaked secrets, env var drift, Dockerfile footguns and GitHub Actions holes.

plugins.name: ship-check-skill
plugins.description: Five skills and two agents: scan for secrets with a rotation-first response, audit env var drift, lint and rewrite Dockerfiles, harden GitHub Actions workflows, and merge it all into a go or no-go report that refuses to say ship it while a high-severity finding is open.
